title: Introduction to Screenwriting for Television or Movies (online)
org: Community Education at Napa Valley College
summary: Two-hour webinar on screenwriting fundamentals: terminology, plotting, character, script format, the difference between treatments, spec scripts and shooting scripts, and the business of selling scripts. Taught by LeeAnne Krusemark.
